title: Mrs Dalloway
author: Virginia Woolf
summary: A London hostess spends a June day in 1923 preparing for an evening party and remembering the choices that shaped her life. Elsewhere in the city a shell-shocked veteran is coming apart.
readIf: you like quiet, lyrical novels where a single day carries a whole lifetime of regret and feeling.
skipIf: you want events, dialogue-driven scenes or a plot that moves from chapter to chapter.

pairings.reason: A direct tribute built around this novel, braiding three women's days together across the twentieth century.
Another delicate portrait of a person looking back at a restrained life and what went unsaid in it.
Shares the focus on ordinary lives and inner weather, but in sharper, more modern short stories.
